privacyPageDescription: Read Queen Land Group's privacy policy to learn how we collect, use and protect personal data across our fertilizer and agricultural services.
privacyIntroText: Queen Land Group for Investment and Development ("Queen Land", "we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect information when you visit our website, request a price offer, review product information, or contact our sales and technical teams. It applies to growers, distributors, agricultural companies and every visitor to our website.
privacyCollectIntro: As part of serving the agriculture and fertilizer sector, we may collect the following types of information:
privacyCollect1: Identity and contact details such as your name, company or farm name, phone number, email address and delivery address.
privacyCollect2: Order and quotation details, including the fertilizer category and product requested (for example suspension, liquid, calcium or superphosphate products) and the required quantity.
privacyCollect3: Agricultural and technical data you choose to share with us, such as crop type, cultivated area, soil and irrigation conditions, and soil or water analysis results, which our agronomists use to recommend suitable fertilization programs.
privacyCollect4: Website usage data such as the pages you visit and the browser or device used, collected through cookies and similar technologies.
privacyCollect5: Communications you send us, including enquiries submitted through our contact form or price-offer request form, and your correspondence with our team.
privacyUseIntro: We use the information we collect for legitimate business purposes connected to fertilizer manufacturing and marketing, including:
privacyUse1: Preparing and following up on price offers, quotations and orders for fertilizer products.
privacyUse2: Providing technical and agronomic support, including customized fertilization and fertigation recommendations for your crops and soil.
privacyUse3: Communicating with you about your requests, our products, delivery schedules and after-sales service.
privacyUse4: Improving our website, product range and services, and understanding the needs of the agricultural market.
privacyUse5: Meeting our legal, accounting and regulatory obligations under applicable Egyptian law.
privacyShareText: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted partners only as needed to fulfil your order or request — for example logistics and delivery providers, our own manufacturing and quality teams, and professional advisers — or where required by law or a competent authority. Any partner who processes data on our behalf is required to keep it confidential and to use it only for the agreed purpose.
privacyRetentionText: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, to maintain commercial and technical records, and to comply with legal and accounting requirements. When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.
privacyCookiesText: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your language preference (Arabic or English) and display preferences, and to help us understand how the site is used. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings; some features of the website may not function optimally if cookies are disabled.
privacySecurityText: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse or alteration, including secure transmission and access controls on our systems. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyRightsIntro: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to:
privacyRights1: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
privacyRights2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacyRights3: Request deletion of your data where there is no legal or contractual reason for us to keep it.
privacyRights4: Object to or restrict certain processing of your data.
privacyRights5: Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
privacyChangesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. The updated version will be published on this page with a revised "last updated" date. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyContactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal data, please contact us at 338 Al Haram Street, Giza, Egypt, by phone at 01110005585, or by email at info@queenland-group.com.

aboutText: Queen Land is part of Queen Land Group for Investment and Development, a leading fertilizer manufacturer in Egypt. Established in 2010, the company manufactures and markets fertilizers with a specialist team of technicians and engineers. We aspire to lead the fertilizer industry and meet the needs of customers in Egypt and worldwide. Our integrated product range includes single and triple superphosphates, rock phosphate, soluble, liquid and suspension fertilizers, foliar fertilizers, growth regulators, micronutrients and bio-stimulants.
singleSuperphosphate: Egyptians Granular Single Superphosphate (15% P₂O₅) SSP
tripleSuperphosphate: Egyptians Granular Triple Superphosphate (46% P₂O₅) TSP
productRange: Our range also includes Queen Touch N-P-K powder, single and triple superphosphates, rock phosphate, foliar fertilizers, growth regulators, micronutrients and bio-stimulants.

faq1Answer: Queen Land Group offers a comprehensive range of plant nutrition products for the fertilizer industry, covering macro, secondary and micro elements. Our portfolio includes suspension fertilizers (the Queen Touch series), liquid and foliar fertilizers, calcium compounds, single and triple superphosphate, rock phosphate, and specialty products such as Big Food, Queen Roots, Phantom Power Plus, Apache (KTS), Borocal, Magnocal, Mok Sal and Nitrocal Boron. We also supply growth regulators, chelated micronutrients and bio-stimulants to meet the needs of field crops, vegetables, orchards and greenhouses.
faq2Answer: To place an order, contact our sales team directly by phone at 01110005585 or 01110005565, or by email at info@queenland-group.com. You can also visit our office at 338 Al Haram Street, Giza, Egypt. Our team will assist you with product selection, order quantity, packaging and order processing.
faq3Answer: Delivery times depend on order size and destination within Egypt. Orders within Giza and Cairo are typically delivered within 2-3 business days, while other governorates may take 5-7 business days. Bulk and export orders may require additional processing time, and our logistics team will confirm a specific delivery schedule once your order is placed.
faq4Answer: Yes. Queen Land Group provides comprehensive technical support for fertilizer application. Our agronomists and engineers advise on the correct product, application rate, timing and method for each crop and soil condition, including fertigation programs for suspension and soluble fertilizers and foliar spray schedules. We also offer soil and water analysis consultation to help you build the most suitable nutrition program.
faq5Answer: Queen Land Group accepts bank transfer, credit cards (Visa and MasterCard) and direct deposit. For commercial, institutional and bulk orders we offer flexible payment terms. Please contact our billing department for specific payment arrangements and invoicing details.
faq6Answer: To choose the right fertilizer, consider the crop type and growth stage, soil pH and nutrient levels, irrigation water quality, climate conditions and the specific nutritional requirements of the plant. We recommend starting with a soil test, then consulting our technical team, who will analyze the results and recommend the most appropriate Queen Land product or combination from our suspension, liquid, granular and foliar fertilizers, together with growth regulators and micronutrients.
faq7Answer: Store Queen Land fertilizer products in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep bags tightly sealed and raised off the ground on pallets or platforms to prevent moisture absorption, caking and nutrient degradation. Do not stack bags too high, and keep products away from incompatible materials such as fuels, oxidizers and pesticides. Always follow the specific storage instructions on each product label and keep products out of reach of children and unauthorized persons.
faq8Answer: Yes. Queen Land Group offers discounts for bulk orders, with the percentage depending on order volume, frequency and customer status. Regular customers, distributors and institutional buyers may qualify for preferential pricing and partnership terms. Contact our sales team for a customized quotation based on your required volume and ordering frequency.
faq9Answer: For technical support and product inquiries, contact our technical department by phone at 02-35869574 or 093-4792105, or by email at info@queenland-group.com. Our team is available during business hours to answer technical questions, provide application guidance and recommend products. You can also visit our office at 338 Al Haram Street, Giza, Egypt.
faq10Answer: When handling Queen Land fertilizer products, always wear appropriate personal protective equipment, including gloves, goggles and a mask. Avoid breathing dust and avoid contact with skin and eyes, and wash hands thoroughly after handling. Keep fertilizers away from food, feed and drinking water. In case of accidental exposure, follow the first aid instructions on the product label and seek medical attention if needed. Store and transport products in their original, labelled containers and follow all local regulations for handling agricultural inputs.
